column5: EX.MM-01.05: The organization regularly assesses a critical third party's program and ability to manage its own suppliers and partners (fourth and nth parties) and the risks those fourth and nth parties may pose to the third party and to the organization (e.g., cybersecurity supply chain risk, concentration risk, reputation risk, foreign-party risk, etc.)

column4: EXTEND / Monitoring and Managing Suppliers / Ongoing Third-Party Monitoring
column5: EX.MM-01.06: The organization regularly reviews the foreign-based operations and activities of a critical third party, or its critical fourth parties, to confirm contract controls are maintained and compliance requirements are managed.

column4: EXTEND / Monitoring and Managing Suppliers / Ongoing Third-Party Management

column4: EXTEND / Monitoring and Managing Suppliers / Ongoing Third-Party Management
column5: EX.MM-02.01: The organization conducts regular third-party reviews for critical vendors to validate that requisite security and contractual controls are in place and continue to be operating as expected.

column4: EXTEND / Monitoring and Managing Suppliers / Ongoing Third-Party Management
column5: EX.MM-02.02: A process is in place to confirm that the organization's critical third-party service providers maintain their business continuity programs, conduct regular resiliency testing, and participate in joint and/or bilateral recovery exercises and tests.

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination
column5: Relationship Termination (EX.TR): Relationship termination is anticipated, planned for, and executed safely

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination / Termination Planning
column5: EX.TR-01: The organization anticipates and plans for the termination of critical relationships under both normal and adverse circumstances

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination / Termination Planning
column5: EX.TR-01.01: The organization establishes contingencies to address circumstances that might put a vendor out of business or severely impact delivery of services to the organization, sector-critical systems, or the financial sector as a whole.

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination / Termination Planning
column5: EX.TR-01.02: The organization periodically identifies and tests alternative solutions in case a critical external partner fails to perform as expected.

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination / Termination Planning
column5: EX.TR-01.03: The organization has a documented third-party termination/exit plan, to include procedures for timely removal of the third-party access, return of data and property, personnel disposition, and transition of services and support.

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination / Termination Practices

column4: EXTEND / Relationship Termination / Termination Practices
column5: EX.TR-02.01: Upon termination of a third-party agreement, the organization ensures that all technical and security matters (access, connections, etc.), business matters (service, support, and ongoing relationship), property matters (data, physical, and intellectual), and legal matters are addressed in a timely manner.
